instruction: - Write out the code. - If new files should be created in codebase provide `touch` fish commands first. - If files require no change but require renaming or moving provide fish commands first. - If any **agentic** CLI actions can be done for ease of implementation of code you provide (except editing a LOT of text), provide all fish commands as well.
important_constraints: - Never write any commented lines within code blocks, unless the file is dedicated to a test. - For files delegated to a test logic refer to a {docs_style_guidelines} - When implementing new logic never keep the backwards compatibility logic. - Focus on simple implementation with minimal diff.
docs_style_guidelines: - Never use `1.`, `2.`, etc... numbering inside documentation comments. - Always write `crates.io` Rust styled inline documentation comments - Style docs in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, to make them clear and straightforward.
